description: P3 coupling. Each worker-agent consumer pins the REFERENCE naming the canonical section — `Blocked: Worker Report — Blocked.` — so drone and changeling must keep pointing at report-format.md's Blocked schema by its section name; deleting or renaming the pointer is loud, and the schema prose itself stays free to improve at the canonical file. cerebrate is deliberately NOT a consumer: cerebrate.md carries no reference to report-format.md, and report-format.md scopes its schemas to worker agents — cerebrate's `blocked` is result-mapping vocabulary the overlord consumes, not the worker YAML schema — so a cerebrate entry here could only ever pin generic prose that discriminates nothing.
